                               State of Rhode Island




JANUARY SESSION of the General Assembly begun and held at the State House in the City
of Providence on Tuesday, the Sixth day of January in the year of Our Lord Two Thousand
and Twenty Six.

 Volume 153, No. 20            Thursday, March 26, 2026              Twentieth Legislative Day

                                      CALL TO ORDER

The Senate meets pursuant to recess and is called to order by The Honorable Valarie J. Lawson,
President of the Senate, at 4:10 o’clock P.M.

                                         ROLL CALL

The roll is called and a quorum is declared present with 36 Senators present and 2 Senators
absent as follows:

PRESENT –36: The Honorable President Valarie J. Lawson, Senators Acosta, Appollonio, Bell,
Bissaillon, Britto, Burke, Ciccone, de la Cruz, DiMario, Dimitri, DiPalma, Euer, Felag, Gallo,
Gu, Kallman, LaMountain, Lauria, Mack, McKenney, Morgan, Murray, Paolino, Patalano,
Raptakis, Quezada, Rogers, Sosnowski, Thompson, Tikoian, Ujifusa, Urso, Valverde, Vargas,
and Zurier.

ABSENT – 2: Senators Famiglietti, and Pearson.


                                        INVOCATION

The Honorable President, by unanimous consent, presents Senator Britto to deliver the
invocation.


                       PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG

The Honorable President, by unanimous consent, presents Senator Britto, to lead the Senate in
the pledge of allegiance to the flag.

Chairman Bissaillon, from the Committee on Housing and Municipal Government, reports back,
with recommendation of passage of the following measures:

Senate Bill No. 2576
(Tiverton)
BY Felag, DiPalma
ENTITLED, AN ACT RELATING TO TAXATION -- LEVY AND ASSESSMENT OF LOCAL
TAXES (Allows the town of Tiverton to apply different tax rates to all classes of property.)
{LC5242/1}

Placed on the Calendar.

Senate Bill No. 2577
(by request)
BY Ujifusa
ENTITLED, AN ACT RELATING TO TAXATION -- LEVY AND ASSESSMENT OF LOCAL
TAXES (Enables the town of Portsmouth to adopt, repeal, or modify their tax classification plan
for any tax year on and after December 31, 2026.)
{LC4951/1}

Placed on the Calendar.

Placed on the Calendar.

BY Bissaillon, Murray, LaMountain, DiMario
ENTITLED, AN ACT RELATING TO HUMAN SERVICES -- MEDICAL ASSISTANCE --
PRESCRIPTION DRUGS (Prohibits the Rhode Island medical assistance program from

Placed on the Calendar.
